stage11Clauses.clause: inspectable command batches with dependencies, source/provider, hashes, authority, and risk
stage11Clauses.evidence: Generic core, cross-producer adapters, typed local-project coverage, and operation-specific project-store batches exist.
stage11Clauses.remaining: Not every current mutating producer is represented in one product-integrated generic review surface; domain-specific repository and Foundry authority remain separate.

stage11Clauses.clause: approve/reject/edit, stale invalidation, undo/redo, cancellation, timeout-as-unknown, reread-before-retry, and recovery receipts
stage11Clauses.evidence: The generic core and bounded local/package slices prove these transitions in selected paths, including M582 typed approval/apply/reread and M466 bounded recovery.
stage11Clauses.remaining: Evidence is distributed across operation-specific history and journals; aggregate every-producer lifecycle coverage remains unproved.

stage11Clauses.clause: human controls, Campaign Director proposals, Technical Builder patches, and Foundry plans share one review vocabulary without sharing authority
stage11Clauses.evidence: Adapter boundaries preserve local-project, repository, and active-GM authority distinctions.
stage11Clauses.remaining: Technical Builder/repository promotion and Foundry desktop execution are separately ordered authority layers, and ordinary human/project-store paths are not one shared product lifecycle.

stage11Clauses.clause: every mutating path has preview, explicit approval, deterministic execution, authoritative reread, and recoverable history
stage11Clauses.evidence: M466 backup promotion, M552 broken-reference reconciliation, and M582 selected missing-asset detach provide bounded packaged evidence; local review and producer closures cover additional paths.
stage11Clauses.remaining: Missing-asset restore still lacks a current packaged visible lifecycle, and no single receipt establishes every producer and recovery family under the current acceptance observation.
